notes.title: Release Update 1.0.0. End of early access! Release RIGHT NOW!!!
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

Today I want to express my deepest gratitude to each of you for becoming a part of our project! Your support, your feedback, and your loyalty have helped us create a game that we are truly proud of.

When we started this journey, all we had was an idea and a strong desire to bring it to life. We knew there would be many challenges ahead, but every day we worked tirelessly to make our game better. We spent countless nights solving complex technical issues, discussing every detail of the gameplay, and creating a world that would capture your attention.

This project became more than just work for us. It was a challenge to ourselves, a drive to prove that dreams can become reality. Each member of our team (me and my wife =)) poured their heart and soul into this game, and thanks to you, it came alive.

We are thrilled that we were able to give you hours of engaging gameplay, vibrant emotions, and unforgettable moments. Your reviews (not too many on Steam) and stories about how our game has become a part of your lives inspire us to keep moving forward and create even more amazing projects.

Thank you for believing in us and supporting us! You are our most valuable players, and none of this would have been possible without you. Keep playing, sharing your experiences, and helping us get better!

Due to the fact that the game has not been a commercial success, we have decided to reduce the price to a minimum in order to make it more accessible for more people to play and share their opinions. Thank you gamers, again!!!

With respect,
Danny Deffoe, The Developer of "Escape from the Nursing Home".

Added

 New items.
 New player buffs and debuffs.
 Many of new diseases.
 Map event system.
 Few customization items.
 NEW ESCAPES!!!
 Detailed disease description.
 So many graphic changes and improvements.


Fixed

 Fixed many visual bugs.
 Fixed some rare bugs. 
 Fixed many any bugs)


Now I will be engaged in a new, better and more interesting project! However, "Escape from the Nursing Home" is not abandoned, and I will release an update as I have time or when it is needed!

Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Update 0.8.1. Speedrun rewards!
notes.notes:
It's been a long time, grandchildrens! How did you celebrate the new Year?

Rewards, new achievements, new character customization elements and a bunch of fixes! That's what brought us the first big update this year.

Now you can get a reward for different events that you can put on your character. These events will happen several times a year. We will release the news with an information of the first reward soon.

You can also get a reward for some hidden events in the game. And of course, the reward and achievement can be obtained for the speedrun of each of the escapes! By the way, there is now a visual reward for getting all the achievements in the game!

P.S. If you have previously completed any escape speedrun, rewards will be given to you as soon as you log into the game.

And here, as usual, is a list of the main changes:

Added

 17 different rewards for character customization.
 11 new achievements.
 Time-limited receipt of New Year's reward.
 Description for all buffs and debuffs! 
 New buff and debuff icons.
 Few new items.

Changed

 Minor UI improvement.

 Minor SFX improvement.
 New improved player mesh.

Fixed

 Fixed wrong security "sight". [Thanks Purpleroni's twitch streams!]
 Minor UI fixes.
 Fixed the inability to get achievements for all achievements.
 Fixed hard-earned game-lock. [Thanks Добрая Пельмеша]

notes.title: Pre-release preparation!
notes.notes:
We have finally started the pre-release preparation of the Steam page! 

Now we are working on inventing achievements. We are sure it would be interesting for you to unlock all of them! Achievements will be divided into several groups, like: simple achievements which you can easily get; unusual challenges which you have to explore; grind (gonna have a hard time with these ones!) and of course we already have several hidden goals that you will have to discover by exploring the territory and mechanics of "Escape from the Nursing Home"!

Now we're getting to work on the gameplay trailer. Also, before the release, we want to make a pack of screenshots for the Steam page with new items and a modified location.

We see a positive reaction from players to the DEMO, so we want to release the game to early access as soon as possible!

See you soon!

notes.title: The Demo version available now!
notes.notes:
Hello there! The demo version of our game "Escape from the Nursing Home" has just become available on Steam. So you can try out a small part of the gameplay right now! We made a demo version as a tutorial, so you can see the basic mechanics of the planned game and have fun with one of the elderly residents of the nursing home, who will help you walkthrough the tutorial. I hope you have a good time with Grandpa the storyteller!

By the way, we spent quite a few hours with our tester! Who would have thought that finding and fixing bugs could be so interesting and fun? But! Despite the long journey to the demo, we could still made mistakes in this version. So we will be doubly happy if you find any problems and write about it! This will help the players of "Escape from the Nursing Home" get the highest quality game we can do. And we really want it!

We had a great journey to that demo and we probably will be glad to see your opinion about the work done!

Have a good Friday, have a good weekend and, of course, have a nice time spent in our "Escape from the Nursing Home: Demo"!

notes.title: Demo version announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi there! We are glad to welcome everyone who is interested in Escape from the Nursing Home!

I am one of the two members of the Simul Games team, and concurrently the only programmer. The development of the game is going pretty well now. All basic mechanics have been completed, so now we are polishing the game - removing bugs and making minor changes to the balance. At the moment we have a few unfinished tasks:  sounds / music, translation into other languages, and some "escapes". I will try posting on Steam weekly - talk about the work done, supplement screenshots and videos, and and also hope to see community interest topics. 

And now about the topic of the post - the demo version.
We decided to release a demo version, in the form of tutorial for the game. This will give everyone the opportunity to try the little part of our game. The tutorial will have very limited functionality and map, however, this is enough for a general concept of game mechanics. Some mechanics are removed from the demo version for simplification.

So. We plan to release a DEMO version on 07/28/2023. Now everything is going according to plan. The demo version is playable, but it also has not finished sounds and translating. I hope it will be interesting for you to go through the demo version. There is only a week left before its release!

I wish everyone a good time, play good games. Good luck to everyone, we'll meet again in a week!
